qualification_environment_incidents.classification: RC qualification contamination caused by an unisolated legacy evaluator; corrected before RC creation
qualification_environment_incidents.summary: During the targeted RC-P10-003 evaluator run, the legacy scripts/eval_release_candidate.py executed company research for the deterministic fixture company Acme without first loading the test-isolation bootstrap. It wrote one cache entry: data/cache/external/be293349a0419d930134b8c6.json.
qualification_environment_incidents.correction: scripts/eval_release_candidate.py now imports tests.conftest before any application import; scripts/eval_rc_p10_003.py enforces, with an AST rule, that every scripts/eval_*.py importing application code bootstraps isolation first (19 further evaluators needed the same import and received it).
qualification_environment_incidents.accepted_baseline: the post-incident cache fingerprint is the accepted pre-RC baseline
qualification_environment_incidents.scope_note: Scope note: the rule covers every CI evaluator (43). Seventeen manual/non-CI evaluators (eval_agent_judge, eval_agent_live, eval_company_intelligence, eval_expanded, eval_external_research, eval_faithfulness_v2, eval_feedback_intelligence, eval_knowledge_retrieval, eval_onboarding_personalisation, eval_opportunity_journey, eval_prepare_practice_integration, eval_quality_v2, eval_rag, eval_ragas, eval_retrieval, eval_retrieval_quality_v2, eval_security) do not bootstrap isolation; they are not run by CI, some are live/opt-in by design, and they are listed as a known follow-up rather than changed here.
